Operations.heading: Operations presentation
Operations.intro: OrgTik staff billing and operations walkthrough. All scene actions are simulated.
Operations.staffBody: Choose OrgTik and Mona or Hany in Demo controls. Customer workspaces do not administer the platform.
Operations.dunningNote: Pause retries, recover a sample invoice and create a local credit-note receipt.
Operations.quantityError: Use a whole quantity from 1 to 100.
Operations.priceError: Enter a valid positive amount within the sample range.
Operations.subscriptionNote: A Tasks subscription example. The half-cycle preview uses the difference from current scene quantity/price.
Operations.currencyNote: Currency changes affect only this scene; no historical invoice or real currency migration changes.
Operations.sampleNote: Historical fictional Nile Foods example. The PDF is a fixed packaged sample, not the selected scene’s invoice.
Operations.paylinkNote: Pay links are local identifiers. Simulated payment creates no platform paid order or invoice.
Operations.taxNote: Deterministic examples only. Use CH-DEMO-001 or SA-DEMO-001; no tax authority check or regulatory submission is performed.
Operations.taxRejected: Sample ID does not match a known example.
Operations.creditImpact: Create a local credit-note receipt for {id}, {amount}. Existing invoices and payment providers are unchanged.
Operations.supportNote: Sample deadlines, merge and replies affect only this local ticket scene.
Operations.mergedNotice: Duplicate scene ticket merged into DEMO-TICKET-1.
Operations.mailSaved: Mailbox preview and demo notification created.
Operations.noticeFailed: Mailbox preview saved; suite notification unavailable. Try the preview again.
Operations.mailboxNote: Local email previews only. Grace extensions are limited to three; existing invoices and shared time remain unchanged.
Operations.nextCycleApplied: Next scene cycle applied. Historical invoices remain unchanged.
Operations.currencyImpact: Keep the current cycle in {current}. From {date}, use {next} and the preview quantity/price. Historical invoices and paid links retain their original currency.

CustomerPreview.heading: Customer preview · {name}
CustomerPreview.intro: A presentation of the selected customer’s workspace using existing staff workspace records.
CustomerPreview.policy: This prototype remains in the staff session. It does not switch identity or issue an impersonation token. Customer changes are unavailable in this preview; the existing View as action records the staff actor and reason.
CustomerPreview.auditedEntry: Opened from the audited read-only View as action.
CustomerPreview.directEntry: Direct presentation preview. Open View as from the staff workspace page to record the reason.
CustomerPreview.noWorkspaceBody: Open a customer workspace in ADM and use View as owner.
CustomerPreview.loadFailedBody: The selected workspace could not be loaded. Retry using the current staff session.
CustomerPreview.name: Workspace
CustomerPreview.seatNote: Capacity comes from the existing subscription snapshot. This summary does not claim live reservation or assignment counts.
CustomerPreview.invoiceNote: Existing invoice references keep their original amount and currency. No invoice action is available here.
